title: Mechanism of interaction between the transactivation domain of N-myc and the DNA-binding surface of TFIIIC5.
authors: Leen, Eoin; Yeoh, Sharon; Sahak, Eka; Mitchell, Ellie; Wildsmith, Gemma; Batchelor, Matthew; Calabrese, Antonio N; Buchel, Gabriele; Bayliss, Richard
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR、HDX-MS及AlphaFold建模研究N-myc转录激活域与TFIIIC5 DNA结合表面的互作机制，属广义蛋白-DNA互作体系，方法含结构预测与实验验证，但非典型TF-DNA结合位点预测或动态模拟，故评7分。
abstract: N-myc is a transcription factor, a powerful driver of cellular growth and an important oncoprotein. N-myc interacts with many factors, including the RNA Polymerase III assembly factor, TFIIIC, a six-subunit complex that is essential for the transcription of small, structured RNA. TFIIIC and N-myc mutually restrict each other's chromatin association, and their complex contributes to quality control in mRNA transcription. We previously demonstrated that the intrinsically disordered transactivation domain of N-myc interacts directly with a sub-complex of TFIIIC, tauA. Structural studies by others show that DNA binding of tauA is largely mediated by TFIIIC3, leaving open the role of the DNA-binding domain of TFIIIC5. Here, we demonstrate that this domain is a binding site for two regions in the transactivation domain of N-myc, through an integrated approach combining NMR spectroscopy, hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry, and interaction assays (pull-downs, ITC, fluorescence polarization, and co-immunoprecipitation). AlphaFold modelling predicts with high-confidence a binding mode for the higher affinity N-myc motif that overlaps with the predicted intramolecular binding site of the C-terminal acidic plug of TFIIIC5, removal of which enhances the binding of N-myc. This model elucidates how the N-myc:TFIIIC5 interaction competes with DNA and other interactions, providing a basis for their mutual regulation.
abstract_zh: N-myc是一种转录因子，是细胞生长的强效驱动因子，也是重要的癌蛋白。N-myc与多种因子相互作用，包括RNA聚合酶III组装因子TFIIIC，这是一个六亚基复合物，对于小型结构化RNA的转录至关重要。TFIIIC和N-myc相互限制彼此的染色质结合，它们的复合物有助于mRNA转录的质量控制。我们先前证明，N-myc的内在无序反式激活域直接与TFIIIC的亚复合物tauA相互作用。他人的结构研究表明，tauA的DNA结合主要由TFIIIC3介导，而TFIIIC5的DNA结合域的作用尚不明确。在此，我们通过整合核磁共振波谱、氢-氘交换质谱和相互作用测定（pull-down、ITC、荧光偏振和共免疫沉淀）的综合方法，证明该结构域是N-myc反式激活域中两个区域的结合位点。AlphaFold建模以高置信度预测了N-myc高亲和力基序的结合模式，该模式与TFIIIC5 C端酸性插头的预测分子内结合位点重叠，去除该插头可增强N-myc的结合。该模型阐明了N-myc:TFIIIC5相互作用如何与DNA及其他相互作用竞争，为它们的相互调控提供了基础。
